decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan; NL-2207-05-DT-002. Received 10/05/2019. Email from Mark Bryan. Received 17/06/2019. NL-2207-05-DT-002 Rev D. Received 30/07/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The brick used for the construction of the wall shall be the reclaimed brick as of email of Mark Bryan dated 17 June 2019 and as shown on the approved drawing NL-2207-05-DT-002 Rev D.

Condition : 4 - Before any above grade works, details of mortar used to erect the wall shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. No other mortar shall be used to erect the wall.

Condition : 5 - No further section of the wall shall be commenced until a two square metres (2 sq m) section of the wall would be first erected on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
